t: The first kingdom to unite the Lao lands along the middle Mekong, founded by Fa Ngum in 1353.
A Buddhist mandala state of semi-autonomous principalities, ruled from Luang Prabang and from 1560 from Vientiane.
A succession crisis after Sourigna Vongsa's death split it into the kingdoms of Luang Phrabang and Vientiane in 1707.
dyk: King Samsenthai's name means 'three hundred thousand Tai', traditionally explained by a census that counted 300,000 Tai men available for royal service.
ev: Fa Ngum is crowned king of Lan Xang
A Vietnamese army sent by Lê Thánh Tông sacks the capital
Setthathirath moves the capital to Vientiane
The great stupa of That Luang is built in Vientiane
Lan Xang becomes a vassal of Burma
The Dutch merchant Gerrit van Wuysthoff visits Vientiane
Lan Xang divides into the kingdoms of Luang Phrabang and Vientiane

f.capital: Xieng Dong Xieng Thong (Luang Prabang); later Vientiane
f.successor: Kingdom of Luang Phrabang; Kingdom of Vientiane; Kingdom of Champasak
